title: Object appears beside the Atlas 8F reentry vehicle at Cape Canaveral
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Object appears beside the Atlas 8F reentry vehicle at Cape Canaveral, about September 1962 at The Atlantic Ocean, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: At the 4 minute and 40 second mark in the video, an object appears to phase itself into existence alongside the re-entry vehicle, which is traveling at 20,000 ft per second or Mach 18.
